discovery.quote: Mercury has been known since ancient times because it can be seen without advanced telescopes.

missions.name: Mariner 10
quotes: Facts in Brief Launch Date: 1973-11-03 Launch Vehicle: Atlas-Centaur Launch Site: Cape Canaveral
Mariner 10 crossed the orbit of Mercury on 29 March 1974, at 20:46 UT, at a distance of about 704 km from the surface.
Engineering tests were continued until 24 March 1975, when the supply of attitude-control gas was depleted and the mission was terminated.

missions.name: MESSENGER
quotes: MESSENGER launched on 3 August 2004 at 6:15:56 UT (2:15:56 a.m. EDT) on a Delta 7925H
Mercury orbit insertion took place with a 15 minute burn starting at 00:45 UT on 18 March 2011
The MESSENGER spacecraft impacted the surface of Mercury as planned on 30 April 2015 at 19:26 UT

missions.name: Spirit (Mars Exploration Rover A)
quotes: Spirit was launched on a standard Delta II 7925 on 10 June 2003 at 17:58:46.773 UT.
The approach phase lasted from this date until martian atmospheric entry on 4 January 2004.
The last transmission from Spirit occurred on 22 March 2010.

missions.name: Opportunity (Mars Exploration Rover B)
quotes: Opportunity was launched on a heavy Delta II 7925H on 8 July 2003 at 03:18:15 UT
The approach phase lasted from this date until martian atmospheric entry on 25 January 2004.
The final communication from the rover was received on 10 June 2018.
